prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a fully designed desktop web application Home screen for Mazi, signed-in shared memory archive for 8 friends. Landscape 1536x1024, straight-on screen capture, no device mockup or presentation annotations. This is an operational memory-browsing interface, never a marketing landing page. Persistent readable navigation: mazi / Home active / Timeline / Search / My Imports / one small group avatar. Synthetic photo content of friends: Mediterranean terrace dinner at dusk, rainy city walks, a lake swim, picnic and birthday table. Selected memory title exactly 'The night we missed the last ferry', metadata 'Summer 2024 · 18 photos · Added by Deniz', visible 'Open memory' action. Small 'Demo memories' label. Design must feel warm and human through large unfiltered full-color photography even where the surrounding system is abstract. No fake metrics, testimonials, public share/publish/privacy controls, likes, AI summaries, notifications, ornamental technology charts, microscopic necessary text, or generic rounded-card dashboard. Every control usable and beautifully spaced. Exceptionally ambitious bespoke studio-quality application design.
STRUCTURE AND WORLD: RETURN TICKETS. Off-white #EEEAE0, charcoal-green #202B29, vermilion #C94B34 only for current selection or changed information. Top navigation slim. Below: a clear 'Return to a moment' title in strong condensed grotesk. Left 34% a beautifully typeset chronological archive BOARD with aligned labeled columns 'WHEN', 'MEMORY', 'PHOTOS'; five event rows and obvious selected row, actual readable names, no flight codes or fabricated airport fields. Right 62% one spectacular dimensional folded archival TICKET object, as a genuine modeled matte card with a shallow V fold and perceptible card thickness, lit with soft contact shadows. Top two thirds of ticket carries the LARGE full-color terrace dinner photograph, lower band divided into title, date, contributor and count; a perforated vertical edge physically divides a narrow stub containing 'OPEN MEMORY →'. The ticket object is clearly a selectable photo memory, not an airline booking. On screen title and Open memory repeated as flat accessible caption below stage only if necessary. Small other moment slips below the board. No QR code, barcode without purpose, boarding gate, price, checkout or booking. No paper aging, scrapbook props or generic photo stack. The folded ticket's spatial opening is the meaningful 3D moment.
